notes.title: First update! Improved English localization and more!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce Mark & Lara: Partners in Justice first update!

Thank you for your feedback, it has been very helpful for improving the game and will continue to be so in the future.

Remember, the game is available on: Windows, iOS, Android, Mac and Linux.

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Improved English localization
[*] Improved the captain's advices
[*] Corrected times and dates in some documents
[*] Added camera shake
[*] Fixed an issue that caused text overflow
[*] Fixed some minor bugs
[/list]

Stay tuned and follow us on:

[url=https://www.facebook.com/DeepMonolith]Facebook[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/DeepMonolith]Twitter[/url]

Good luck and have fun, Detectives! 

Deep Monolith Team
